Caroline —

Appreciate the worksheet. I did an initial pass and flagged questions that will need artifact pulls vs. short written responses. Quick notes up-front:
- SOC 2 report: we can provide our latest Type II report (redacted) and evidence index.
- ISO 27001: we can provide scope statement and Statement of Applicability (SoA) but don’t have a public full certificate PDF for the private deployment option until next quarter.
- KMS / Keys: we can provide architecture diagrams and KMS access-control screenshots (owner-blind logs).

Before we start extracting artifacts, two asks so we scope the sprint correctly: 1) which SIG control families are highest priority for Larkwell (Data Protection, Logical Access, or Change Management)? 2) Are redaction guidelines required for any PII in logs?

I’ll loop Marissa for control mapping and Ben for commercial alignment. Proposed internal kickoff today 3pm PT to triage the sheet. If that works, we’ll follow up with a delivery plan and owners.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Trust & Security — Redwood Inference

Thanks, Marissa and team —

Priority list for us:
1) Data Protection (we need assurance on encryption at rest, key separation, tenant isolation)
2) Logical Access (role-based access, SSO, MFA enforcement)
3) Incident Management (SLAs, notification windows, root-cause artifacts)

Redaction: yes, any log-level artifacts with customer identifiers must be redacted. We accept sanitized exports and screenshots.

One question: for key ownership, will you be able to show separation of duties screenshots (KMS policies + audit log entry showing admin action) or do we need a formal attestation letter?

Caroline Ross
Sr. Procurement Manager — Larkwell Financial

Caroline / Tim —

Thanks for the priority guidance — we put together a delivery roadmap and evidence sprint plan attached. High level:
- Week 1 (by 10/31): deliver mapping workbook with SIG -> Redwood control IDs, and sanitized screenshots for KMS and SSO config.
- Week 2 (by 11/07): provide SOC 2 Type II redacted report + SoA excerpt for ISO controls requested.
- Week 3 (by 11/14): provide deeper artifacts (audit logs excerpts redacted, change management records).

Regarding your key ownership question: we can provide KMS policy screenshots and an audit log snippet that demonstrates separation-of-duties (example admin action with metadata). If Larkwell requires a formal attestation letter, we can arrange a one-page attestation signed by our CISO (Marissa) — let us know which you prefer.

Attachments: redwood-app-architecture-v2.pdf, kms-keyflow-diagram.png

Next steps: confirm acceptance of the proposed dates and whether Larkwell would like the attestation letter in addition to screenshots. Once confirmed we will open ticket RLW-457 in our intake queue and share the GH workspace for artifact exchange.
